modelNotes: Threes Board 1.0 uses season threes, last 5 threes, last 10 threes, three point attempts, attempt trend, expected minutes, minutes confidence, and usage.
Threes Board 2.0 adds minutes scaling, opponent three rank, pace, rest, teammate absence redistribution, volatility, and floor/ceiling ranges.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: Da Silva (calf) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game at Utah.
injury.detail: Da Silva has a chance to return from a one-game absence due to a left calf strain. The Magic could be extremely shorthanded in the frontcourt Wednesday, as Jamal Cain (shoulder) is also in danger of joining Paolo Banchero (ankle) on the inactive list.

injury.shortComment: Herro (knee) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against the Lakers.
injury.detail: Herro is in jeopardy of missing a second consecutive contest due to a right knee contusion. If the star guard remains on the inactive list, Ryan Rollins would likely stay in the starting five, while Kasparas Jakucionis could continue seeing increased burn off the bench.

injury.shortComment: Wilson has been downgraded to questionable for Wednesday's game against the Spurs due to right hip soreness.
injury.detail: Wilson was a late addition to the injury report and will likely be a game-time decision ahead of tipoff at 8:00 p.m. ET. If the rookie forward isn't cleared to play, Leonard Miller and Noa Essengue would likely see increased playing time.

injury.shortComment: Quickley (hamstring) is questionable for Wednesday's game against Boston.
injury.detail: Quickley has a chance Wednesday to end a two-game absence with a hamstring injury. Jamal Shead would have the most to lose from a fantasy perspective if Quickley is able to return.

injury.shortComment: Traore (calf) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against New Orleans.
injury.detail: Traore has played well throughout the 2026-27 campaign. He has appeared in 10 regular-season games, starting seven, and has averaged 12.9 points, 2.0 rebounds, 2.6 assists and 1.4 steals while shooting 46.2 percent from deep over 22.1 minutes per contest. The 20-year-old is now in danger of missing his first game of the season Wednesday versus New Orleans. If that happens, Mikel Brown, Keon Ellis and Terance Mann are candidates for more minutes. Egor Demin (leg) is also expected to suit up after being sidelined since the 125-124 overtime loss to Boston on Oct. 27.

injury.shortComment: Murphy (knee) is doubtful for Wednesday's game against the Nets.
injury.detail: Murphy was initially listed as probable but is now expected to miss a second straight game. If the sharpshooter is ruled out, it'll be his third absence over the past five games, with only one of them coming during a back-to-back set. Saddiq Bey and Herbert Jones are candidates for increased roles until Murphy returns to action.

injury.shortComment: Towns (calf) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against Cleveland.
injury.detail: Towns may be held out of the second half of this back-to-back set due to a sore left calf. If the star big man is unable to play, Andre Drummond, Mohamed Diawara and James Wiseman would be candidates for increased playing time.

injury.shortComment: Powell (shoulder) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game versus the Spurs.
injury.detail: Powell didn't suit up for Sunday's 127-121 loss to Philadelphia, marking his first absence of the 2026-27 campaign. Isaac Okoro took his place in the starting lineup, and that will likely remain the case if Powell misses a second consecutive game Wednesday.

injury.shortComment: Cain is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Jazz due to a left shoulder contusion.
injury.detail: With Tristan da Silva (calf) joining Paolo Banchero (ankle) and Jalen Suggs (knee) on the sidelines, Cain started Tuesday against the Kings, posting five points, three rebounds, one assist and one steal in 20 minutes. Da Silva joins Cain as questionable for the second night of a back-to-back set, so Jase Richardson and Jevon Carter could be candidates for increased roles if both questionable players are ruled out.

injury.shortComment: George (ankle) is questionable for Wednesday's game against Orlando.
injury.detail: George has a chance to return from a one-game absence due to a right ankle sprain. If the 23-year-old guard is cleared to play, fewer minutes would be available for the likes of Isaiah Collier and Svi Mykhailiuk.

injury.shortComment: Vassell (groin) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game versus the Bulls, NBA reporter Matthew Tynan reports.
injury.detail: Vassell missed his first game of the season in Monday's 122-96 victory over the Suns. As a result, Julian Champagnie entered the starting lineup. If Vassell remains sidelined against the Bulls, Champagnie is expected to stay with the first five.

injury.shortComment: Richard (thumb) has been upgraded to probable for Wednesday's game at Houston.
injury.detail: Richard is expected to play through a torn UCL in his left thumb. Over his last five games (two starts), the 23-year-old has averaged 5.2 points, 2.0 rebounds and 1.6 assists in 18.2 minutes per tilt.

injury.shortComment: Stewart (knee) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game versus the Nuggets.
injury.detail: Stewart has played well in his first season in Memphis, averaging a career-high 11.9 points while shooting 57.1 percent from downtown. He has missed the last two games due to a bone bruise in his right knee. If Stewart remains sidelined Wednesday, GG Jackson and Taylor Hendricks are candidates for more minutes.

injury.shortComment: Murray-Boyles (illness) is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Celtics.
injury.detail: The Raptors are likely to check back in with Murray-Boyles closer to Wednesday's tipoff. Jamison Battle would handle an expanded role in the frontcourt if Murray-Boyles ends up sitting out.

injury.shortComment: Collins (illness) is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Spurs.
injury.detail: Collins is in danger of missing his second straight game due to an illness. If he's out again, Jalen Smith and Leonard Miller would likely split Collins' minutes.

injury.shortComment: McConnell is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Wizards due to a strained right hamstring.
injury.detail: The Pacers continue to monitor the veteran floor general's status after he missed the onset of the campaign. More playing time at point guard would be available for Quenton Jackson if McConnell winds up sitting out Wednesday.
